topic: Account info endpoints for RoALT (users, thumbnails, economy, premium/Plus, friends, presence, email/2FA/PIN), verified 2026-10-24 against Roblox swagger (docsiteassets), create.roblox.com legacy docs, DevForum staff posts, roblox.com's own live JS bundles, open-source tools, and unauthenticated curl probes. No cookie was ever sent.

findings.claim: Swagger for every legacy subdomain now redirects to prod.docsiteassets.roblox.com. All legacy cookie APIs carry a 'may break without notice' warning, and since 15 Apr 2026 Roblox says they are 'for ... usage by humans only', with lower rate limits from 4 May 2026.
findings.detail: GET https://<sub>.roblox.com/docs/json/v1 returns 302 with Location https://prod.docsiteassets.roblox.com/assets/en-us/cloud/legacy/<sub>/v1.json. auth.roblox.com/docs/json/v1 returns 404, but docsiteassets .../legacy/auth/v1.json works. The economy, presence and premiumfeatures v2 docs return 403 (none published). The DevForum announcement 'Roblox Data Stewardship Principles & Cookie-based API Update' (staff, 15 Apr 2026, devforum.roblox.com/t/4579220) quotes 'Cookie-based APIs are officially for supporting Roblox website and application surface usage by humans only'. It removes unauthenticated access on some endpoints and changes rpm limits for 200+ endpoints, effective 4 May 2026. Rows for this topic are listed under A5, A12, A15, A19 and A11. create.roblox.com legacy pages (updated 2026-10-23) all warn: 'Legacy APIs with cookie authentication can incorporate breaking changes without notice.'

findings.claim: GET https://users.roblox.com/v1/users/authenticated is the correct cookie validator. It returns {id,name,displayName}. Without a cookie it now returns the gateway error 9002, not the swagger's '0: Authorization has been denied'.
findings.detail: Auth: .ROBLOSECURITY cookie. No CSRF (GET). 200 schema (swagger Roblox.Users.Api.AuthenticatedGetUserResponse): id (int64), name (string), displayName (string). Observed with no cookie: HTTP 401 with body {"errors":[{"code":9002,"subcode":0,"message":"Authentication token is missing"}]}. The swagger still lists only 401 '0: Authorization has been denied for this request.' For an INVALID or expired cookie, a community measurement (agildw/roblox-presence-tracker docs/429-incident.md, Oct 2026) reports 401 with 9002, subcode 3, 'User is not authenticated'. This was not verified here because the rules forbid sending a cookie. Observed rate-limit header without a cookie: x-ratelimit-limit '100, 100;w=60'. The same community source reports '300, 300;w=60' for an invalid cookie. Sibling self-only GETs on the same host: /v1/users/authenticated/age-bracket returns {ageBracket:int32}, /country-code returns {countryCode:string}, /roles returns {roles:[string]}. Each returns 401 9002 without a cookie, and age-bracket showed rate header '30, 30;w=60'. Suggested TTL: validate at startup, before every launch, and every ~15 min. Cache {id,name,displayName} for 1 h.

findings.claim: An invalid cookie is NOT rejected by public-data endpoints such as presence. They return 200 and treat the caller as anonymous, so only users/authenticated (any 401) reliably detects a dead cookie.
findings.detail: Community measurement, Oct 2026: POST presence.roblox.com/v1/presence/users with an invalid cookie returned 200, byte-identical to the no-cookie response, under the anonymous rate-limit bucket. A valid session showed an extra window in x-ratelimit-limit (e.g. '60, 60;w=60, 100;w=60'). That doc also says 429s from a dead cookie usually lack Retry-After. RoALT should branch on HTTP 401 from users/authenticated, not on message text, because the swagger text and the gateway text differ.

findings.claim: GET https://users.roblox.com/v1/users/{userId} is public. It returns description, created, isBanned, externalAppDisplayName, hasVerifiedBadge, id, name and displayName. Its unauthenticated limit is very tight (30/min).
findings.detail: No auth. Observed for id 1: {"description":"...","created":"2006-02-27T21:06:40.3Z","isBanned":false,"externalAppDisplayName":null,"hasVerifiedBadge":true,"id":1,"name":"Roblox","displayName":"Roblox"}. Swagger notes externalAppDisplayName is 'Unused, legacy attribute ... always null'. Invalid id 0 returns 404 {"errors":[{"code":3,"message":"The user id is invalid."}]}. Headers: x-ratelimit-limit '30, 30;w=60', cache-control no-cache. The swagger lists x-roblox-recommended-alternatives GET https://apis.roblox.com/cloud/v2/users/{user_id}, but that is Open Cloud and needs an API key or OAuth. Without one it returns 403 {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":"Invalid authentication data provided"}]}, so it is unusable with cookies. Suggested TTL: 24 h, since created never changes and isBanned rarely does. Fetch once per account, not per refresh.

findings.claim: POST https://users.roblox.com/v1/users does batch name lookup: at most 200 ids, no CSRF, returns {data:[{hasVerifiedBadge,id,name,displayName}]}.
findings.detail: Request body (swagger MultiGetByUserIdRequest): {"userIds":[int64] (maxItems 200), "excludeBannedUsers":bool}. The swagger states 'Does not require X-CSRF-Token protection because this is essentially a get request but as a POST'. 201 ids returns 400 {"errors":[{"code":1,"message":"Too many ids."}]} (observed). Rate header '1000, 1000;w=1'. Missing ids are omitted. Sibling endpoint POST /v1/usernames/users takes {usernames:[string], excludeBannedUsers} and returns data[{requestedUsername,hasVerifiedBadge,id,name,displayName}], with 400 code 2 'Too many usernames.' and the same no-CSRF note. It also matches previous usernames. Suggested TTL: 1 h for names.

findings.claim: GET https://thumbnails.roblox.com/v1/users/avatar-headshot: 11 allowed sizes, formats Png/Jpeg/Webp, at most 100 ids per call, two new optional params, and a 120/min unauthenticated limit.
findings.detail: Query params (swagger): userIds is CSV and required; size is one of 48x48,50x50,60x60,75x75,100x100,110x110,150x150,180x180,352x352,420x420,720x720 (default 48x48); format is Png|Jpeg|Webp (default Png); isCircular true|false (default false); includeBackground bool (default false, new); includeProfileFrame bool (default false, new). Response (no schema in swagger; observed): {"data":[{"targetId":1,"state":"Completed","imageUrl":"https://tr.rbxcdn.com/30DAY-AvatarHeadshot-310966282D3529E36976BF6B07B1DC90-Png/150/150/AvatarHeadshot/Png/noFilter","version":"TN3"}]}. version can read 'TN3 - cached'. Errors: 101 ids returns 400 code 1 'There are too many requested Ids.'; size 999x999 returns 400 {"code":3,"message":"The requested size is invalid...","field":"size"}; swagger also lists code 2 (format), code 4 (ids invalid) and code 10 'Circular thumbnail requests are not allowed'. Non-existent user ids are silently omitted from data. Observed header '120, 120;w=60'. Data Stewardship (4 May 2026): unauthenticated 10000 to 120 rpm, cookie 10000 to 500 rpm. No auth needed.

findings.claim: Thumbnail states seen were Completed, Pending and Blocked. Pending has imageUrl "" (empty string, not null) and resolved within about 2 s on retry. Error, InReview and TemporarilyUnavailable also exist per Bloxstrap but were not observed.
findings.detail: Observed: 100 uncached ids at 720x720 Jpeg with includeBackground=true gave 97 Pending (imageUrl "") and 3 Blocked. Re-requesting about 2 s later gave 94 Completed and 6 Blocked, so Pending can turn into Blocked. Blocked rows have imageUrl "" OR a placeholder like https://tr.rbxcdn.com/180DAY-87249609dae614261c1058785f217b72/352/352/UnapprovedImage/Webp/noFilter. The full state list comes from Bloxstrap's ThumbnailResponse model (commit 2026-08-05): Error, Completed, InReview, Pending, Blocked, TemporarilyUnavailable. Retry practice: Bloxstrap retries up to 5 times with a 500ms*i delay while any row is Pending. noblox retries 2 times at 500 ms and only re-requests the Pending ids. Recommendation: re-request only the Pending ids, with 0.5/1/1.5/2 s backoff and at most about 5 tries, then show a placeholder. Never retry Blocked.

findings.claim: imageUrl hosts are NOT only tr.rbxcdn.com: t0 through t7.rbxcdn.com also appear, and the URL layout varies. Treat the URL as opaque and allow *.rbxcdn.com.
findings.detail: Host counts across 97 completed URLs: t3 23, t1 20, t0 17, t5 13, t2 7, t6 6, t4 4, t7 4, tr 3. The 720x720 URL form has no size path, e.g. https://t6.rbxcdn.com/30DAY-AvatarHeadshot-CC7F3A498559A1C7BB30EC26E196EFD4-Jpeg. The 150 form is .../30DAY-AvatarHeadshot-<HASH>-Png/150/150/AvatarHeadshot/Webp/isCircular. CDN headers seen: t6.rbxcdn.com returned 'Content-Type: image/jpeg' and 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000'; tr.rbxcdn.com returned 'Content-Type: image/Png' (even for a Webp request path the original key is Png), 'Cache-Control: no-cache' and Age 5575067. The '30DAY'/'180DAY' prefix appears to be a retention class (inferred). Suggested TTL: re-resolve the headshot URL every 1-6 h or after an avatar change. Cache image bytes keyed by the URL, since the hash changes when content changes. Set the Tauri CSP img-src to https://*.rbxcdn.com.

findings.claim: POST https://thumbnails.roblox.com/v1/batch handles mixed thumbnail requests: at most 100 entries, no CSRF without a cookie, and the response adds requestId, errorCode and errorMessage.
findings.detail: Body: a JSON array of {requestId:string, targetId:int64, type:'AvatarHeadShot', size:'150x150', format:'Png'|'Jpeg'|'Webp', isCircular:bool}. Optional fields per swagger: token, alias, accessContext, headShape, includeBackground, includeProfileFrame. Optional header Roblox-Place-Id. Response: {"data":[{"requestId":"1:AvatarHeadShot:150x150:webp","errorCode":0,"errorMessage":"","targetId":1,"state":"Completed","imageUrl":"https://tr.rbxcdn.com/...","version":"TN3"}]}. 101 entries returns 400 code 1 'There are too many requested Ids.' (observed). Rate header '60, 60;w=1'. Not listed in the Data Stewardship changes. Used by Bloxstrap.

findings.claim: Robux: the only documented endpoint is GET https://economy.roblox.com/v1/user/currency, which returns {robux:int64} for the cookie's own account. The older /v1/users/{id}/currency route still answers (401, not 404) but is undocumented.
findings.detail: economy v1 swagger (and the create.roblox.com economy page, updated 2026-10-23) has exactly one path: GET /v1/user/currency, 'Currency can only be retrieved for the authenticated user.' 200 returns {"robux":int64}; 401 '0: Authorization has been denied'; 403 '1: The user is invalid.' Without a cookie both routes return 401 9002. A nonexistent economy path returns 404 {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":""}]}, which proves /v1/users/1/currency is still routed. noblox still uses /v1/users/{id}/currency. Observed unauthenticated rate headers: /v1/user/currency '500, 500;w=60'; /v1/users/1/currency '20, 20;w=60'. www.roblox.com/mobileapi/userinfo (used by the original RAM) now returns 404. Cookie, no CSRF. Suggested TTL: 60 s to 5 min, refresh on demand.

findings.claim: Premium: GET premiumfeatures.roblox.com/v1/users/{id}/validate-membership is still live but hidden and marked 'planned for deprecation on 4/30 (Roblox Plus launch)'. Premium stopped selling on 30 Apr 2026.
findings.detail: Swagger x-documentation-category 'Hidden', with description 'Endpoint planned for deprecation on 4/30 (Roblox Plus launch)'. premium-upsell-precheck carries the same note. Without a cookie it returns 401 9002 (route alive), with rate header '30, 30;w=60'. 200 has no schema; the body is a bare JSON boolean (noblox: resolve(res.body === 'true')). roblox.com's live ProfileHeader bundle (fetched 2026-10-24) still builds the URL '<premiumfeaturesApi>/v1/users/<id>/validate-membership' withCredentials. Roblox Plus launched 30 Apr 2026 ($4.99/mo) and replaced new Premium sign-ups. Existing Premium members keep their plans, but some Premium benefits ended 30 May 2026. Whether validate-membership reports Plus subscribers is UNKNOWN. Cookie required. Suggested TTL: 24 h.

findings.claim: Plus status (and names) for any user: POST https://apis.roblox.com/user-profile-api/v1/user/profiles/get-profiles with fields including 'hasRobloxSubscription'. roblox.com itself uses this. It needs no auth or CSRF, and above 200 ids it silently returns an empty result.
findings.detail: Seen in roblox.com's live FriendsCarousel bundle: url = apiGatewayUrl + '/user-profile-api/v1/user/profiles/get-profiles', withCredentials, body {userIds:[...], fields:["names.combinedName","isVerified","hasRobloxSubscription"]}. The web maps isRobloxPlus = hasRobloxSubscription === true. Observed without a cookie: 200 {"profileDetails":[{"userId":1,"names":{"username":"Roblox","displayName":"Roblox","combinedName":"Roblox"},"isVerified":true,"hasRobloxSubscription":true}],"errors":[]}. Valid field names seen in bundles: names.combinedName, names.username, names.displayName, isVerified, hasRobloxSubscription. TRAPS: more than 200 userIds, or an unknown field such as 'isPremium', returns 200 {"profileDetails":[],"errors":[]} with no error. Rate header '10000, 10000;w=60'. Not in the Data Stewardship list. This endpoint is undocumented, so it may change. For a self-check with a cookie, the web uses GET https://apis.roblox.com/access-management/v1/upsell-feature-access?featureName=IsRobloxPlusSubscribed&namespace=subscriptions%2FPlusSubscription and treats data.access === "Granted" as subscribed. Without a cookie that returns 403 RFC 9110 problem+json. Data Stewardship removed unauthenticated access to it from 4 May 2026. Suggested TTL: 6-24 h.
sources: https://js.rbxcdn.com/ (FriendsCarousel and Navigation bundles referenced by https://www.roblox.com/users/1/profile)

findings.claim: Friend, follower and following counts are still live and public at the same paths. The 'Connections' rename was UI-only and was reverted to 'Friends' in April 2026 with no API changes.
findings.detail: GET https://friends.roblox.com/v1/users/{userId}/friends/count returns {count:int32}. GET /v1/users/{targetUserId}/followers/count and /followings/count return {count:int64}. Observed for id 1: friends 0, followers 16821485, followings 0, each with rate header '100, 100;w=60'. Swagger marks these Hidden ('RedesignNeededBeforeAutomation', target date 2026-06-01); they are still live after that date. Data Stewardship (4 May 2026): friends/count, followers/count and followings/count are now 100 rpm both without and with a cookie. The followers and followings LISTS lost unauthenticated access. The DevForum post 'Friends Are Back!' (2 Apr 2026) says 'There are no API changes'; Connections and Trusted Connections became Friends and Trusted Friends again. Self-only GET /v1/my/friends/count needs a cookie (401 9002 without one) and is limited to 100 rpm with one. Suggested TTL: 15-30 min.

findings.claim: Friends list: GET /v1/users/{id}/friends returns an unpaged full list, but name and displayName are now EMPTY strings (ids only) and the limit is 20/min. GET /v1/users/{id}/friends/find is the paged version (limit at most 50, ids only).
findings.detail: Observed without a cookie for user 261: 98 rows, all shaped {"id":4371992339,"name":"","displayName":""}. None of the swagger UserResponse fields (isOnline, presenceType, isDeleted, created, ...) are returned. Rate header '20, 20;w=60'. Whether the names are populated with a cookie is unknown. /friends/find params: userSort 0|1|2 (default 2; roblox.com uses ?userSort=1), cursor, limit (default 50; 51/100/200 return 400 {"errors":[{"code":6,"message":"Invalid parameters.","userFacingMessage":"Invalid parameters."}]}), findFriendsType 0=FindFriends, 1=FindTrustedFriends. Response is PascalCase: {"PreviousCursor":null,"PageItems":[{"id":4371992339}],"NextCursor":"1:636167423083800000","HasMore":null}. HasMore was null in practice, so loop until NextCursor is null. Rate header '100, 100;w=60' (Data Stewardship: 100 rpm without and with a cookie). Resolve names through A11 (get-profiles, up to 200) or A4 (POST /v1/users, up to 200). Suggested TTL: 5-10 min.

findings.claim: Online friends: GET https://friends.roblox.com/v1/users/{userId}/friends/online needs a cookie and returns presence in PascalCase (UserPresenceType as a STRING like "InGame") plus gameInstanceId. roblox.com's friends carousel uses exactly this.
findings.detail: Without a cookie: 401 9002, rate header '100, 100;w=60'. Swagger is Hidden ('RequiresHumanPresence'), with no paging or limit parameter (userSort 0|1|2 only). Schema: data[{id, name, displayName, sortScore(double), userPresence{UserPresenceType:string, UserLocationType:string, lastLocation, placeId, rootPlaceId, gameInstanceId(uuid), universeId, lastOnline}}]. Live roblox.com bundle reads userPresence.UserPresenceType === "InGame", lastLocation, gameInstanceId, universeId and placeId. It then calls get-profiles (A11) for names and the Plus badge, and /friends/find for the offline list. Note the casing differs from the presence API (camelCase userPresenceType int, gameId). Not in the Data Stewardship list. Suggested TTL: 30-60 s, and poll only while the Join-user picker is open.

findings.claim: POST https://presence.roblox.com/v1/presence/users takes {userIds}. lastOnline is gone, last-online returns 404, batches are capped at 50 ids without a cookie, and limits are 60 rpm without and 100 rpm with a cookie.
findings.detail: OpenAPI 3 schema (docsiteassets): UserPresence {userPresenceType: enum [0,1,2,3] (unnamed), lastLocation (nullable string), placeId, rootPlaceId, gameId (uuid string), universeId, userId}. There is NO lastOnline field. Historical names from the 2023 swagger: 'Offline'=0, 'Online'=1, 'InGame'=2, 'InStudio'=3, 'Invisible'=4, but the current enum lists only 0-3. Observed without a cookie: {"userPresences":[{"userPresenceType":0,"lastLocation":"Website","placeId":null,"rootPlaceId":null,"gameId":null,"universeId":null,"userId":1}]}. Offline users show lastLocation "Website". 51 ids returns 400 {"errors":[{"code":3,"message":"Too many User Ids being sent in the request."}]}. An empty array returns 200 {"userPresences":[]}. Unknown ids still get an offline row. POST /v1/presence/last-online returns 404 (deprecated 28 Oct 2024, returned arbitrary values from 15 Nov 2024, now removed). Since 15 Nov 2024, users with friends-only presence show online status only to authenticated friends. Observed rate header '60, 60;w=60'. Data Stewardship: unauthenticated 2640 to 60 rpm, cookie 1320 to 100 rpm. Studio sessions can show lastLocation 'Studio - <name>' with universeId null (DevForum bug, Sep 2025). No CSRF needed without a cookie; whether CSRF is needed with a cookie is unconfirmed (noblox always fetches a token first). Suggested polling: 30-60 s, only for accounts visible in the UI.

findings.claim: Presence privacy: placeId, rootPlaceId, gameId and universeId are null for callers without a cookie and for viewers the target's privacy settings exclude. A logged-in viewer gets fuller data. Whether your own cookie always shows your own gameId is unconfirmed.
findings.detail: DevForum thread (June 2025, community only): a Swagger test while logged in returned full fields, while incognito returned basic fields only, and the poster fixed it by sending a Cookie header. Community replies tie the remaining nulls to the 'Who can join me' and visibility settings; there is no staff confirmation. The staff post of 28 Oct 2024 covers only friends-only online status. The roblox.com friends carousel relies on gameInstanceId from friends/online for joinable friends. Inferred, not verified: querying your own userId with your own cookie should return your own gameId. RoALT should treat a null gameId as 'not joinable or hidden'.

findings.claim: Email: GET https://accountsettings.roblox.com/v1/email (cookie) returns {emailAddress (masked), verified, canBypassPasswordForEmailUpdate}. accountinformation.roblox.com/v1/email does not exist (404).
findings.detail: Swagger Roblox.AccountSettings.Api.EmailResponse: emailAddress (string, 'The masked and formatted email address'), verified (bool), canBypassPasswordForEmailUpdate (bool). GET /v1/emails returns {verifiedEmail, pendingEmail}, both masked. Both are Hidden ('AgainstPolicy'). Without a cookie: 401 9002, rate header '10000, 10000;w=60'. accountinformation.roblox.com/v1/email returns 404 {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":""}]}; that host only has POST /v1/email/verify. The masking format is unknown. Suggested TTL: 24 h, refresh on demand.

findings.claim: 2FA: GET https://twostepverification.roblox.com/v1/users/{userId}/configuration (own userId plus cookie) returns {primaryMediaType, methods:[{mediaType, enabled, updated}]}. Without a cookie it returns 400 'Invalid challenge ID', not 401.
findings.detail: Swagger UserConfiguration: primaryMediaType int enum 0-7; methods[] of UserConfigurationMethod {mediaType: int ['Email'=0,'SMS'=1,'Authenticator'=2,'RecoveryCode'=3,'SecurityKey'=4,'CrossDevice'=5,'Password'=6,'Passkey'=7], enabled: bool, updated: date-time}. Optional query challengeId and actionType (0-8) are for an unauthenticated challenge context. Without a cookie, observed 400 {"errors":[{"code":1,"message":"Invalid challenge ID."}]}. Swagger also lists 403 '2: The user ID is invalid.' for a userId that is not the caller's. Rate header '3000, 3000;w=60'. GET /v1/users/{userId}/recovery-codes returns status (401 without auth, 503 code 7 during maintenance). Suggested TTL: 24 h.

findings.claim: Account PIN and phone: GET https://auth.roblox.com/v1/account/pin returns {isEnabled, unlockedUntil}. GET https://accountinformation.roblox.com/v1/phone returns phone details. Both need a cookie.
findings.detail: auth v1 swagger AccountPinStatusResponse: isEnabled (bool), unlockedUntil (number/double). Without a cookie: 401 9002, rate header '1000, 1000;w=60'. PATCH /v1/account/pin exists (do not use). Phone (swagger PhoneResponse): countryCode, prefix, phone, isVerified, verificationCodeLength, canBypassPasswordForPhoneUpdate. Data Stewardship removed unauthenticated access to /v1/phone. Public GET accountinformation.roblox.com/v1/metadata returns flags, e.g. isPhoneNumberEnabled:false, MaxUserDescriptionLength:1000 (rate header '1000, 1000;w=60'). Suggested TTL: PIN status 5 min (unlockedUntil is short-lived); phone 24 h.

findings.claim: CSRF: GETs never need it. POST /v1/users and /v1/usernames/users are documented as CSRF-exempt. roblox.com's own HTTP client handles CSRF generically: on a 403 that carries an x-csrf-token response header, it sets that header and retries. It also handles rblx-challenge-* headers.
findings.detail: Observed in the live CoreUtilities bundle: if status === 403 and the response has the 'x-csrf-token' header, it sets the request header and retries. It also reads 'rblx-challenge-id', 'rblx-challenge-type' and 'rblx-challenge-metadata' to run a generic challenge (captcha/2SV) and retries with those headers, and adds 'x-retry-attempt'. Without a cookie, POSTs to presence/users, thumbnails/batch and user-profile-api/get-profiles all returned 200 without any token. noblox fetches a token by POSTing auth.roblox.com/v2/logout without a token. That is risky (with a valid token attached it logs the session out), so do not copy it. The swagger's 403 'Token Validation Failed' (code 0) is the CSRF failure body.

findings.claim: Rate limits are advertised per endpoint through x-ratelimit-* headers. A real 429 returned retry-after: 5, x-ratelimit-reset: 30, the new header x-retry-after-coverage, and the body {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":""}]}.
findings.detail: Header format: 'x-ratelimit-limit: 20, 20;w=60' (IETF RateLimit-draft style; w is the window in seconds), plus x-ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-reset (seconds). The 429 was reproduced on GET friends.roblox.com/v1/users/1/friends at the 22nd request in about 24 s. Headers: retry-after: 5, x-ratelimit-reset: 30, x-retry-after-coverage: /v1/users/{userId}/friends/, content-type application/json. Observed unauthenticated limits: users/authenticated 100/60s; users/{id} 30/60s; POST users 1000/1s; headshot 120/60s; thumbnails batch 60/1s; friends list 20/60s; friends count/find/online 100/60s; friends/statuses 10000/60s (Data Stewardship: 200 rpm with a cookie); presence 60/60s; economy /v1/user/currency 500/60s; /v1/users/{id}/currency 20/60s; premium validate 30/60s; 2SV config 3000/60s; get-profiles 10000/60s. The docs advise 'Retry with exponential backoff starting at 1s'. Whether cookie limits are counted per account or per IP is not stated (Data Stewardship lists only 'Cookie' and 'Unauth' rpm).

findings.claim: Route liveness: an unknown path returns 404 {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":""}]}, while a live auth-only route without a cookie returns 401 9002. Static references in roblox.com bundles do not prove a route is alive.
findings.detail: 404 bodies were observed for economy /v1/users/1/doesnotexist, /v9/zzz, premiumfeatures and users. The PresenceStatus bundle still references '/v1/presence/last-online' and '/v1/presence/set-invisibility-status', yet last-online returns 404. Use the 401-vs-404 distinction in a startup health check to detect removed endpoints.

open_questions: Exact 401 body for an INVALID or expired .ROBLOSECURITY on users/authenticated: a community source reports 9002 subcode 3 'User is not authenticated', but this could not be checked because no cookie may be sent.

Does POST presence/users with a cookie require X-CSRF-TOKEN? Is the authenticated batch limit still 50 or larger? Does your own cookie always return your own gameId/placeId, regardless of your own join-privacy setting?
Does GET /v1/users/{id}/friends return non-empty name/displayName when called with a cookie? Unauthenticated, all names are empty strings.
After the Plus launch, what does premiumfeatures validate-membership return for Plus-only subscribers, and is it also scheduled for removal? Swagger says 'planned for deprecation on 4/30'.

user-profile-api get-profiles is undocumented: is unauthenticated access, or the 200-id cap, likely to change? Note that ids 1 and 156 report hasRobloxSubscription:true, probably because they are staff accounts.
Are cookie-authenticated rate limits counted per account (session) or per IP? This decides whether bulk-refreshing N accounts from one PC multiplies the budget.
The thumbnail states Error, InReview and TemporarilyUnavailable were not observed live (sourced from Bloxstrap only), so their imageUrl shape is unknown.
Masking format of accountsettings /v1/email emailAddress, e.g. 'a***@g***.com', is unknown.
Type of friends/statuses 'status': swagger says int 0-3, but one community Tauri manager's tests use the string 'Friends'.
design_implications: Validate a cookie only with GET users.roblox.com/v1/users/authenticated and treat ANY 401 as invalid; do not match on message text (swagger says code 0, the live gateway says 9002). Never infer validity from presence or other public endpoints, because they answer 200 as anonymous.

Split calls in two. Public data goes WITHOUT a cookie in global batches across all accounts: POST users/v1/users (≤200), get-profiles (≤200, names + Plus), thumbnails (≤100), presence (≤50). Self-only data goes with that account's cookie: currency, email, 2FA config, PIN, friends/online, Plus self-check.
Guard batch sizes in code: get-profiles silently returns an empty list above 200 ids or for an unknown field name. Assert that the response count equals the request count, or log it.

Build one Rust HTTP layer: on 403 with an x-csrf-token header, store the token per account and retry once. Surface rblx-challenge-* 403s as 'needs browser verification' and do not retry. On 429, honour retry-after (fallback: exponential backoff from 1 s), then x-ratelimit-reset. Log x-retry-after-coverage. Never fetch CSRF via auth/v2/logout.

Throttle per endpoint from the x-ratelimit-limit header, not from hard-coded numbers. Keep a per-host token bucket shared across accounts for unauthenticated calls, and assume cookie budgets may also be shared per IP until confirmed.
